label: Review requests changes, loops back to execute
description: Acceptance review returns changes_requested, so the loop routes back to execute to close the specific gaps before a second review accepts.
scenario: The first acceptance review finds specific, fixable gaps against the criteria and returns changes_requested. Rather than terminating, the loop routes back to execute so the same initiative closes the gaps; the second execute pass finishes cleanly and review then accepts before reconcile aligns the backlog.

initiative.title: Unify the audio-session lifecycle
initiative.description: A pass where the first acceptance review requests concrete fixes before accepting.
criteria: An idle tab never holds the system audio session.
The microphone recovers after backgrounding without an app restart.

steps.note: verdict=changes_requested → execute (loop back to close the gaps)
